question_text: A hose can fill a 600-liter government water tank in 4 hours. Another hose can fill the same tank in 6 hours. How much water can they fill together in 1 hour?

hint_ladder.title: Think in Terms of Rates
hint_ladder.text: Instead of the whole tank, ask: how much water does each hose deliver in just one hour? That's key to 'working together' problems.

hint_ladder.title: Find Each Hose's Hourly Output
hint_ladder.text: Hose A fills 600L in 4h, so per hour: 600/4 = 150L. Hose B: 600/6 = 100L per hour. Compute each.

hint_ladder.title: Combine Their Efforts
hint_ladder.text: When both hoses are open at the same time, their hourly outputs simply add up. Take the two numbers you found and add them together.

hint_ladder.title: Match Your Sum to the Options
hint_ladder.text: Hose A gives 150L/hr, Hose B 100L/hr. Sum: 250L/hr. Since we need exactly 1 hr output, answer is 250L.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you only used one hose's rate or divided 600 by the average time of 3 hours, missing the combined effort.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you averaged the times or rates instead of adding them, a common error that gives 120 L/hr or 125 L/hr.

C.text: Correct. You correctly computed each hose's rate (150 L/hr and 100 L/hr) and added them to get 250 L/hr.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you made a small arithmetic slip, like using 125 instead of 100 for Hose B's rate, getting 275 as the sum.

next_time_rule: For combined work problems, find each worker's rate per unit time, then add the rates. Never average the times or rates.
deconstruct_text:
Ikaw ang Barangay Kagawad na nagmamadaling punuin ang 600-liter water tank bago magsimula ang feeding program. Ang secret? Tignan muna ang kayang gawin ng bawat hose sa loob ng isang oras.

Unang hose: kayang punuin ang buong tanke sa loob ng 4 oras. Kaya sa 1 oras, ang napupuno nito ay 600 ÷ 4 = 150 liters.

Pangalawang hose: 6 na oras ang kailangan para mapuno ang tanke, kaya sa 1 oras, 600 ÷ 6 = 100 liters ang kanyang naiaambag.

Ngayon, pagsamahin natin. Kapag sabay na bumubuhos ang dalawang hose, nagtutulungan sila. As simple as pag-add ng kanilang isang-oras na output: 150 + 100 = 250 liters.

Dahil ang tanong ay kung ilang litro sa eksaktong 1 oras, 250 liters ang sagot. Hindi mo na kailangan isipin ang buong tanke—just add the hourly rates.

For a mental trick: isipin mo si Juan at Pedro na nag-iigib ng timba. Si Juan, 3 timba kada oras; si Pedro, 2. Pag pinagsama, 5 timba per hour—kasi ina-add lang, hindi ina-average. Same logic!
